steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; g.env.setTime(11); g.env.weather.cloud=0.2; g.env.weather.cloudTarget=0.2; g.env.weather.rain=0; g.env.weather.rainTarget=0; g.env.weather.timer=9999; g.hud.firstShown=-1000; g.hud.hint('',0); __rhf.god(true); g.state.salmonRun={place:'landing'}; const p=g.world.place('landing'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face); g.player.pitch=-0.42; return 'ok'})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const s=g.fish.schools[0]; if(!s) return 'none'; const P=g.player.pos; g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-(s.x-P.x),-(s.z-P.z)); const d=Math.hypot(s.x-P.x,s.z-P.z); g.player.pitch=-Math.atan2(g.camera.position.y-s.level+0.6,d); return 'look at school '+s.species+' d '+d.toFixed(1)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const p=g.world.place('landing'); g.player.yaw=p.face; g.player.pitch=-0.3; const f=g.fishing; f.startCast(); f.meter={phase:1,t:0,needle:0.1,power:0.42,acc:0}; f.releaseCast(); return 'cast '+f.state})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let i=0;i<300;i++){ if(f.encounter){ f.encounter.dur=6; return 'approach started '+f.encounter.fish.species; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return 'no encounter '+f.state})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const fl=g.fishing.float.position; const P=g.player.pos; g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-(fl.x-P.x),-(fl.z-P.z)); g.player.pitch=-Math.atan2(g.camera.position.y-fl.y,Math.hypot(fl.x-P.x,fl.z-P.z)); return 'aim at float'})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let i=0;i<400;i++){ const e=f.encounter; if(e && e.phase==='bite'){ __rhf.press('primary'); return 'hooked at '+i; } if(e && e.phase==='approach'){ e.t=Math.max(e.t,e.dur-0.05); } if(e && e.phase==='nibble'){ e.nibbles=0; e.gap=0; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return 'no bite '+f.state})()

(()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const F=f.fight; if(!F) return 'no fight '+f.state; F.state='swim'; F.stateT=9; F.dist=Math.min(F.dist,9); F.tension=f.rod().maxTension*0.4; __rhf.hold('primary', true); return 'fight '+F.fish.species})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const F=g.fishing.fight; if(!F) return 'no fight'; F.stateT=9; const P=g.player.pos; g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-(F.pos.x-P.x),-(F.pos.z-P.z)); g.player.pitch=-Math.atan2(g.camera.position.y-F.level,Math.hypot(F.pos.x-P.x,F.pos.z-P.z)); return 'dist '+F.dist.toFixed(1)})()
